items.title: Positive-gamma cushion COMPRESSES and the pin band WIDENS as spot extends to a fresh high with IV rising on a frozen completed-bar frontier: from the morning 10:14:20Z options cut to the pre-close 14:14:26Z cut on the SAME frozen 2026-08-03 daily-bar frontier, SPY signedNetGEX contracts ~68% (+4.682B → +1.502B) while staying positive, the pin band WIDENS (put/call walls 758/765 → 755/775, span 7 → 20 pts; front expected move ±4.83 → ±6.48; atmIV 17.07% → 22.68%), spot advances to a new session high (764.71 → 772.02, bench 766.33 → 772.4) — and VIX ticks UP with price (15.86 → 16.51) rather than falling, while leadership stays narrow (breadth 57.53%) and no new completed bar is added.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the four prior same-frontier axes. The 'frozen-frontier pre-market markdown' tracked live BENCH repricing (price axis); the 'coverage-expansion-on-frozen-frontier' tracked owner tools flipping to fresh reads (coverage axis); the 'gamma-band-migration-on-frozen-frontier' tracked the dealer band RELOCATING UP while its strength was roughly held (band-position axis); and the 'wall-cross-on-frozen-frontier' tracked price crossing THROUGH a STATIC band (price-through-static-band axis). This is a fifth, distinct axis — a CUSHION-STRENGTH axis: the band neither merely relocates nor stays static; its net GEX MAGNITUDE collapses (~-68%) and the wall span roughly TRIPLES (7 → 20 pts) as spot makes a new high, so the positive-gamma pin is THINNING and WIDENING rather than moving. The notable divergence is co-directional: in positive gamma a new price high usually pairs with FALLING IV/VIX, but here atmIV (17.07% → 22.68%) and VIX (15.86 → 16.51) both RISE alongside price — a weakening dealer cushion with richening front vol into new highs. Emit only when net GEX compresses AND the wall span widens AND spot makes a new session high AND VIX/atmIV rise together on a frozen frontier with narrow breadth, so a quiet re-read that leaves the cushion strength and band width unchanged does not trip the flag.
items.method: Add a 'gamma-cushion-compression-with-pin-widening-on-frozen-frontier' composite test that compares two options cuts on the SAME session frontier (dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate unchanged AND swing bar count unchanged AND freshSymbolCount==symbolCount with carriedSymbolCount==0 and missingSymbolCount==0). Assert SIX joint conditions: (1) FRONTIER FROZEN across the two cuts; (2) FRESH OPTIONS CUT = the dealer-gamma options asOf advances (2026-08-04T10:14:20Z → 2026-08-04T14:14:26Z); (3) CUSHION COMPRESSION = signedNetGEX contracts beyond a threshold (here +4.682B → +1.502B, ≈-67.9%) while remaining strictly positive; (4) PIN WIDENING = the wall span (callWall − putWall) expands beyond a tolerance (here 765−758=7 → 775−755=20 pts) with the front expected move also widening (±4.83 → ±6.48); (5) NEW-HIGH ADVANCE = spot / bench advances to a new session high across the cuts (spot 764.71 → 772.02; bench 766.33 → 772.4); (6) CO-DIRECTIONAL VOL-UP GUARD = VIX AND atmIV both RISE across the cuts instead of falling (VIX 15.86 → 16.51; atmIV 17.07% → 22.68%), with market-heatmap breadth still narrow (57.53%). Emit the experimental flag only when (1) AND (2) AND (3) AND (4) AND (5) AND (6) all hold; the vol-up-into-new-highs condition (6) marks the divergence from the usual positive-gamma price-up / vol-down pairing.
